|lore=Kadas'sa'Nikto. Barada's main assistant. In charge of repairing Jabba's skiffs. Gambler. Always tries to make it back to the palace to watch the Rancor get fed.
|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. Power +2 when with Barada or defending a battle a a Jabba's Palace site. During a battle at same site, may forfeit a transport vehicle present to satisfy all remaining battle damage and attrition against you.
|joke=Klaatu is named from the phrase "Klaatu barada nikto" in the 1951 film ''The Day the Earth Stood Still''.
